registration_statement: Written and committed in its own commit before any Python-vs-Rust comparison of this component was executed. No Rust code for the component exists at registration. The commit is recorded in the report, not here.

reference_implementation.rule: the campaign refuses to score (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) if any reference file sha256 differs from sha256_at_registration; a changed reference requires a new contract version

environment.stdlib: math (glibc libm: exp, log, sqrt, pow through float ** float), json, hashlib; CPython 3.11 float repr and format(x, '.Ng') correctly rounded

rust_implementation.rust_commit: FILL at scoring time (recorded in the report build_provenance, not here)
rust_implementation.rule: the report records the sha256 of every provenance source; any later change is UNRECORDED_SOURCE_CHANGE until a scoring execution records it

governing_hashes.architecture_hash: NOT_APPLICABLE (no configuration file is read; the single flight configuration is hall_icp_neutralizer, A9.19)
governing_hashes.rule: both implementations read the same pinned inputs (pinned_inputs_sha256); a mismatch voids the run (INPUT_MISMATCH, not a verdict)

frozen_data_read_only: the committed P4 record: read only

inputs.argument_encoding: JSON-shaped records as the builder passes them; evaluate_gate args {req, prop, thermal_closure_status, operating_temperature} (absent = the Python default None)

list_or_generator.R-P01: for every committed gate cell: evaluate_gate(requirement record, prop chosen as build_p4_anode_materials.run_screening chooses it from the record's property_records, thermal status from fixed_statuses for min_with_margin)
list_or_generator.R-P02: candidate_screening_state over each candidate's outcomes of R-P01 (Python outputs); final_material_status for each application with the states
list_or_generator.R-P03: a registered synthetic branch walk (SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE): min / max satisfied and violated, OUT_OF_DOMAIN, unit mismatch, min_with_margin with CLOSED_BY_EVIDENCE and an evidenced T_operating (satisfied / violated), UNRESOLVED, a T_validated_continuous property with stage-1 / 2 / 3 records (valid and each refusal)

edge_cases.inputs: non-dict req / prop; missing each required field
value / value_si True, nan, inf, int, str
operating_temperature None / list / missing keys / unit degC / value 0 / class 'assumed'

stage record: non-dict, NON_VALIDATION basis, unknown basis, missing preregistered_acceptance, T_limit_K 0 / nan / True, criteria_met False, stage-1 conditions missing, short exposure, stage-2 without stage-1, wrong material, configuration / article, environment missing, stage-3 without stage-2, accelerated without justification, sha mismatch, declared stage mismatch, material mismatch, value mismatch

randomized_domain.draw: start from a registered synthetic base (one per gate kind; for T_validated a valid stage-2 or stage-3 chain) and apply 0..3 mutations, each replacing one field by a value from its pool (registered statuses / kinds / units / numbers incl. ints, True, nan, inf, strings, None, domains as sub- / super-sets, stage-record fields incl. TBD / PENDING / NOT_ / OPEN strings) or dropping it; outcome lists of 0..6 draws from GATE_OUTCOMES (+ 'PASS' with probability 0.02)
randomized_domain.domain_note: structural parity domain only. Excluded: ints beyond 2**53, non-ASCII strings in case-folded fields, non-JSON values

campaign_seeds.applicable: true (input generation only; the component is deterministic)

rng_stream_roles.rule: A9.29 sec. 7 (RM-OQ-03): design / UQ sampling uses exact registered stream parity; TPMC particle tracing uses the admitted statistical contract; the roles are never merged
rng_stream_roles.other_streams: NOT_APPLICABLE: the harness's random.Random only generates input cases (the component is deterministic and draws no random numbers)
rng_stream_roles.migration_parity_dataset: seeds and the generated call file stay exactly reproducible (immutable)

campaign_seeds.development_rule: development comparisons use development_master_seed (and the registered deterministic vectors) only and are never scored or reported as a verdict; every execution with scoring_master_seed is appended to campaign_history and the report is committed whatever its verdict

list.name: value
list.definition: the returned value (dicts in insertion order, tuples as lists)

list.name: error_class
list.definition: Python exception class name; Rust reports the mapped class name

list.name: error_message
list.definition: str(exception) character for character for the message classes listed; class only otherwise

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: strings, ints, booleans, None, statuses, dict key order, list lengths and the int-vs-float type of every value equal; error class equal; messages equal for the registered message classes
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: every float: |rust - py| <= 4 ulp(py) or <= 1e-12 * max(1, |py|); NaN matches NaN, +-inf exact

exact_invariants.statement: determinism: the Rust call list evaluated in two separate processes gives byte-identical output
no PASS / SELECTED / WINNER / QUALIFIED string in any returned value (both)
every R-P01 evaluate_gate outcome is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, as every committed gate-matrix cell (352) - both

mapping.AttributeError: AttributeError (stage-1 'conditions' not a mapping); class scored
mapping.KeyError / TypeError: the same class (malformed record); class scored

domain_and_error_parity.mapping_rule: every Python exception class maps to exactly one Rust class name; no Rust path may return a value where Python fails, or fail where Python returns, except the registered divergences (CLAUDE.md rule 3)

references: the committed P4 record gate matrix (R-P01 / INV-P02)
golden_and_reference_cases.rule: references are read as committed; they are never regenerated to make Rust pass (RM-R11)

captured_reference_outputs.purpose: lets CI check Rust against the Python reference after Python is retired from active execution

golden_and_reference_cases.historical_golden_rule: RM-R28: no golden_v1 / golden_v2 case is used

performance_measurement.status: reported, not a decision criterion (A9.24 items 1 and 6)
performance_measurement.statistic: median wall-clock per implementation in one session on one machine; speed-up = median_python / median_rust (Rust timed inside life_eval)

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every call meets its tolerance class
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED (= PARITY_PASS) iff every call of every vector, every invariant, every conservation check and every registered divergence outcome passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED (PARITY_FAIL)
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, evidence record or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: restricted to the retained selected-architecture functions listed (RM-R20)
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust (abep_subsystems::life::p4) becomes authoritative for the fail-closed P4 gate kernels within the registered domain; the anode / collector material stays OPEN and every committed gate cell INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE

bid_boundary.statement: post-bid-freeze work; no output of this contract may be cited by the bid package unless the owner re-freezes

what_this_is_not: not physics evidence or validation: parity shows the Rust code reproduces the Python reference, not that either is right
not a change of any frozen dataset, golden, evidence record, threshold or requirement
not authority before admission: until ADMITTED the Python reference is authoritative
not a promotion of any provisional input (RM-R27): literature-class priors stay priors

not a gate PASS and not a life verdict: absent determining evidence stays NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / MODEL_ERROR (RM-R31); no 15,000 h / 26,280 h comparison is made in raw physics (SC-WP-11)
